name: com.dtf.face.ocr.ui.OcrGuideBaseActivity
description: In the older Ant Digital OCR SDK, this general screen presents document-capture guidance and handles camera permission and photo review; the normal flow opens separate front- and back-side guides. Disabling this entry prevents the general screen from opening directly.
disableEffect: Only direct launches of this general guide are blocked; the SDK's separate front- and back-side guide screens remain available.
